about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a relaxing and sensual puzzle experience.
Progress through 27 handcrafted levels of increasing challenge, each designed to test your logic and soothe your mind. Accompanied by gentle, ambient music, every moment invites you to unwind and lose yourself in the rhythm of the game.

As you advance, you’ll unlock three captivating girls, each with her own distinct charm and personality:

  • Luna, the emo goth, mysterious and melancholic, hides her emotions behind dark eyeliner and quiet glances. Her soft voice and subtle smiles will draw you in as you uncover her artistic, vulnerable side.

  • Elysia, the elegant elf, radiates grace and serenity. Her ethereal beauty and calm aura make every interaction feel otherworldly — a gentle spirit who finds joy in small moments of connection.

  • Rin, the gyaru cowgirl, brings the energy of a wild sunset — confident, playful, and teasing. Beneath her bold fashion and flirty attitude, there’s warmth and sincerity waiting to be discovered.

Take your time and explore their full artworks in the Gallery Mode, unlocked as you complete their respective levels.

For those who simply wish to relax and enjoy the atmosphere, activate Love Mode (press L) to instantly complete any level and focus on the story and visuals.

Note: This game contains suggestive and erotic imagery and is intended for adults only.
